label: System76 Lemur Pro
description: 14/16-inch Linux ultrabook (Intel Core Ultra, up to 73Wh battery); System76 lists only the Intel BE200 Wi-Fi 7 card.
notes: Zero Ethernet: the spec sheet lists no wired NIC at all, only Wi-Fi 7 + BT 5.4. Wired requires a USB-C dock or dongle (1GbE in practice) - the cleanest example of a Linux laptop with no RJ45.
